description: List the caller's active subscriptions (requires a free Pipeworx account; an empty list means none created yet, see subscribe). Returns id, type, params, created_at, last_fired_at, fire_count for each. Use this to review what you're monitoring before adding more or to find an id to cancel.

include_inactive.description: Include cancelled subscriptions in the response (default false).

name: newswire-com__list_subscriptions
